bundle.shortDescription: Identify bird groups of India with probabilities, photos and species lists
bundle.longDescription: Version 2 (2026): identify the group of an Indian bird from a sitting or flying bird, with visible probabilities, best next question, credited photos, Catalogue of Life species lists, IUCN status, records by state and month, comparison and search. Works offline.
